name: Start, Stop, Continue
trigger: Operational drift during standard bi-weekly sprint cadences; teams requiring a direct, low-friction mechanism to discard counterproductive habits and institutionalize emerging engineering practices.

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite Kerth's Prime Directive verbatim; one-word check-in.
Gather data (15m): silent notes; Start missing, Stop wasteful, Continue working.
Generate insights (15m): cluster themes; three dot votes each on Stop and Start.
Decide (20m): top-voted items become bounded experiments via the action converter.
Close (5m): owners and dates confirmed; rate the session 1–5.

action: Every Stop item names the constraint that replaces it: two required approvals, one owner, a date.
provenance: Source protocol: the phases and minutes follow the written sequence in the source.

origin.note: A common retro format; no documented originator.
